Política de gestión de credenciales

A formal set of rules and procedures for creating, storing, rotating, and revoking authentication credentials to ensure security and regulatory compliance.

Definition

A formal set of rules and procedures for creating, storing, rotating, and revoking authentication credentials to ensure security and regulatory compliance.

Operational example

Develop a Credential Management Policy to standardize how passwords, API keys, and certificates are provisioned, stored, and rotated across the enterprise.
